dedicated.name: Jane's Shadow Clan Salary Contract

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Jane by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"The heck is this?! I want more, no, I deserve more! Haven't you guys heard the words "hazard pay" around here?!

Contract renewal season at the Shadow Clan had returned, and like clockwork, Jane loudly and vehemently voiced her dissatisfaction over the new salary on the contract sent her way. Conversely, Sera beamed cheerfully as she skipped off with her contract in her hands — and even Black Rose studied her own contract with a look of distinct satisfaction. This only soured Jane's mood further, and she shot Ballista the dirtiest, most withering glare she could muster — but Ballista simply shrugged it off, hardly even perturbed.

"Just you wait! Someday, you'll be practically begging me to work for you — and you'll be paying me a fortune to do it!"

lore:
Jane is a selfish, impulsive woman who relies on her instincts and desires more than any kind of rational thinking.
This has carried her far in life because her primal intuition is unmatched.
Jane was originally a part of the Moonlight Guard on the Moonlit Isles, but she betrayed them and is now being tracked down by her former colleague, Rei.
Considering that Rei is known to be persistent if nothing else, Jane has had her share of troubles.
Despite this, Jane has been able to complete mission after mission for the Shadow Clan, becoming a high-ranking member in her own right.
She has recently earned the nickname "Silent Killer" for her tendency to conduct hits without a single hitch or disturbance.
She looks down on the dark elf twins Ellen and Ellin and considers them rivals, albeit ones that are mere nuisances rather than an actual threat.
